title: Continuous Technology Observatory
purpose: Continuously identify authoritative technologies and convert material opportunities into governed, actionable AIAS recommendations.
scope: Authorized sources, secure host validation, cadence, injected fetching, deduplication, scoring, radar, persistent cycles, AEC-000050 recommendations and ACE consumption.

requirements.title: Authorized sources
requirements.statement: The observatory shall poll only approved HTTPS source hosts with explicit cadence and evidence strength.
requirements.rationale: Control provenance and external attack surface.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Continuous cycles
requirements.statement: The observatory shall determine due sources and persist cycle execution evidence.
requirements.rationale: Turn observation into a durable operating loop.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Deduplication
requirements.statement: Repeated observations shall not create duplicate opportunities or recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Technology radar
requirements.statement: Admitted observations shall receive reproducible scoring and radar classification.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Strategic recommendation
requirements.statement: Giant-step observations shall emit the complete AEC-000050 recommendation content.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: ATO shall include tests, documentation, installer, manifest, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
